EXTRAORDINARY

LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Ministry of Agriculture, Lands, Livestock, Irrigation and Aquatic Resources Ref. No.: 4-3/18/2021/WS/23. My Ref. No.: DSWA/LND/4/ACQUI/F1/45. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land/Servitude intended to be acquired: Description of the allotment of land depicted as Lot No. 01 in the Cadastral Map No. 830457, situated at Pahalawatta Grama Niladhari Division No. 554, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Walasmulla, in Hambantota District, Southern Province and bounded as follows: Lot No. 1 - Cadastral Map No. 830457 Name of the Land: Welangahakumbura; Current Usage of the Land: Home garden, two water tanks and a

pump house are situated; Claimant: State; Extent: 0.0379 Hectare. All persons who claim ownership, interest or any other connection to the aforesaid land/servitude are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at 10.00 a.m. on 16.06.2025 at the Divisional Secretariat, Walasmulla. And further, you are hereby requested to notified me in writing in duplicate on or before 02.06.2025, the nature of their interests in the land/servitude, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. Kඎආඎൽඎ C. Lඈ඄ඎඁൾඐൺ඀ൺආൺ, Divisional Secretary, Walasmulla. At the Divisional Secretariat, Walasmulla. EOG 01- 0183
